entities.label: Companion ASCII tree contract
entities.summary: The single companion artifact is an independently generated mapped tree rooted at `NEW DIAGRAM REPOSITORY`. It exposes exact D0-D9 labels, places D1-D5 under `RUNTIME CORE`, D6-D8 under `INTERACTIVE STUDIO`, and D9 under `EVALUATION AND TOOLING`, shows the dependency spine without duplicate detail nodes, annotates primary source boundaries, and maps every diagram label to its matching Markdown section.

originalLines: The companion tree is generated independently from this Markdown document and
persisted as a mapped Diagram artifact. It should:
- have one root named `NEW DIAGRAM REPOSITORY`;
- expose D0 through D9 using the exact labels in this plan;
- group D1 through D5 under `RUNTIME CORE`, D6 through D8 under
`INTERACTIVE STUDIO`, and D9 under `EVALUATION AND TOOLING`;
- show the dependency spine without duplicating detail nodes;
- annotate each diagram branch with its primary source boundary; and
- map every diagram label to the corresponding section in this document.

entities.label: Portfolio dependency spine
entities.summary: The concise principal spine is `D1 -> D2 -> D3 -> D5 -> D6 -> D7/D8`; D4 underpins D1-D8, while D9 consumes outputs from D3 and D4. The generation order further explains that evidence precedes generation, mapped artifacts precede stable representations, and the studio shell precedes specialized D7/D8 interactions.
